title: Washington state wildfires force 60,000 people to evacuate homes
facts: Wildfires forced approximately 60,000 people to evacuate in Washington state.
Lisa Brown serves as the Mayor of Spokane, Washington.
Washington's Department of Natural Resources reported 16 large, uncontained wildfires burning across the state.
Wildfires destroyed approximately 700 buildings around the city of Spokane.
Avista Utilities reported that over 10,000 electricity customers lost power due to the fires.
Washington State Governor Bob Ferguson declared a statewide emergency regarding the wildfires.
Governor Bob Ferguson requested federal disaster assistance after conferring with US President Donald Trump.
The Old Trails, Fairview, and Autumn Lane fires were collectively designated the Spokane Complex Fires.
High winds caused the Spokane Complex Fires to jump across the Spokane River twice.
Major General Gent Welsh serves as commander of the Washington National Guard.
Spokane County Sheriff John Nowels directed search efforts for 14 unaccounted individuals.
Governor Bob Ferguson implemented a statewide prohibition on all outdoor burning.
Dave Upthegrove serves as Washington's Commissioner of Public Lands.
More than 900 firefighters were deployed to battle active wildfires in Washington state.
Unauthorized civilian drone activity disrupted aerial firefighting operations 26 times in Spokane.
